issues.title: TypeLoadException at boot after a mod or Harmony update
issues.explanation: A mod was built against a different Harmony version than the one loaded, so its assembly fails to load and every def it adds disappears.
issues.fix: Make sure Harmony (brrainz.harmony) and the named mod are both up to date, and that only one copy of Harmony is active. Remove any mod that ships its own 0Harmony.dll.

issues.title: Example: NullReferenceException from Example Mod when selecting a pawn
issues.explanation: This is a template entry. Replace the fields with a real bug. Example Mod throws when a colonist has no ideoligion because it assumes one always exists.
issues.fix: Update Example Mod to 1.3 or later, or enable Ideology. As a workaround, avoid the mod's Foo feature in its settings.
